identity_evidence: NARA's published OSS history names Captain Robinson O. Bellin as an X-2 Rome unit chief and cites his RG 226 reports and symposium notes. The printed first-name form Robinsono is preserved as indexed.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The biography places these civilian occupations after his 1941 move to San Francisco and before Army entry in June 1943.

claims.temporal_assessment: Documented pre-service occupations. The source does not name the employers or establish which job was last.
